name: band reverse wrist curl
instructions: Stand with a resistance band secured under your feet. Grasp the band with an overhand grip and curl your wrists upwards, then lower and repeat.

name: band wrist curl
instructions: Stand with a resistance band secured under your feet. Grasp the band with an underhand grip and curl your wrists upwards, then lower and repeat.

name: barbell palms down wrist curl over a bench
instructions: Sit on a bench and place your forearms on your thighs with your wrists over the edge. Hold a barbell with an overhand grip and curl your wrists upwards, then lower and repeat.

name: barbell palms up wrist curl over a bench
instructions: Sit on a bench and place your forearms on your thighs with your wrists over the edge. Hold a barbell with an underhand grip and curl your wrists upwards, then lower and repeat.

name: barbell reverse wrist curl v. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip. Curl your wrists upwards, then lower and repeat.

name: barbell reverse wrist curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip. Curl your wrists upwards, then lower and repeat.

name: barbell standing back wrist curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell behind your back with an overhand grip. Curl your wrists upwards, then lower and repeat.

name: barbell wrist curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an underhand grip. Curl your wrists upwards, then lower and repeat.

name: barbell wrist curl v. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an underhand grip. Curl your wrists upwards, then lower and repeat.

name: cable reverse wrist curl
instructions: Stand with a cable machine set to a low position. Grasp the handle with an overhand grip and curl your wrist upwards, then lower and repeat.

name: cable standing back wrist curl
instructions: Stand with a cable machine set to a low position. Grasp the handle with an underhand grip behind your back and curl your wrist upwards, then lower and repeat.

name: cable wrist curl
instructions: Stand with a cable machine set to a low position. Grasp the handle with an underhand grip and curl your wrist upwards, then lower and repeat.

name: dumbbell finger curls
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand. Let the dumbbells roll down to your fingers, then curl your fingers to lift the dumbbells back up.

name: dumbbell lying pronation
instructions: Lie on your back with a dumbbell in each hand. Rotate your wrists to turn the dumbbells from a palms-up to a palms-down position, then return and repeat.

name: dumbbell lying pronation on floor
instructions: Lie on your back with a dumbbell in each hand. Rotate your wrists to turn the dumbbells from a palms-up to a palms-down position, then return and repeat.

name: dumbbell lying supination
instructions: Lie on your back with a dumbbell in each hand. Rotate your wrists to turn the dumbbells from a palms-down to a palms-up position, then return and repeat.

name: dumbbell lying supination on floor
instructions: Lie on your back with a dumbbell in each hand. Rotate your wrists to turn the dumbbells from a palms-down to a palms-up position, then return and repeat.

name: dumbbell one arm reverse wrist curl
instructions: Sit on a bench and place your forearm on your thigh with your wrist over the edge. Hold a dumbbell with an overhand grip and curl your wrist upwards, then lower and repeat.

name: dumbbell one arm seated neutral wrist curl
instructions: Sit on a bench and place your forearm on your thigh with your wrist over the edge. Hold a dumbbell with a neutral grip and curl your wrist upwards, then lower and repeat.

name: dumbbell one arm wrist curl
instructions: Sit on a bench and place your forearm on your thigh with your wrist over the edge. Hold a dumbbell with an underhand grip and curl your wrist upwards, then lower and repeat.

name: dumbbell over bench one arm reverse wrist curl
instructions: Sit on a bench and place your forearm on your thigh with your wrist over the edge. Hold a dumbbell with an overhand grip and curl your wrist upwards, then lower and repeat.
